title: Animalia Exotica
description: Animalia - mod that adds animals to the world.
body:
# Animalia Animalia is a Vanilla+ Minecraft mod focused on making the world feel more alive and diverse through new animals while staying true to the style and atmosphere of vanilla Minecraft. Each animal is designed to feel like a natural part of the world, with its own behavior, movement, and personality, making encounters during exploration and survival more interesting and memorable. ## What the mod adds Animalia adds new animals to Minecraft with smooth animations and more detailed behavior while preserving the Vanilla+ visual style. The mod aims to make the world's wildlife feel more alive and diverse, so that every animal feels like a meaningful part of the environment rather than just another mob. ## Animalia Animals ![Jaguar](https://i.imgur.com/QRaUkUp.png)
Spoiler * Jaguar * Crocodile
## Planned Features The roster of animals in Animalia will continue to expand in future updates. ## Community Follow the development of the mod, share ideas, and stay updated here: **YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs](https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs) **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz](https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz) ## Development Status Animalia is currently in active development, with new animals, animations, and features planned for future updates.
